This PR implements distributed rate limiting using Redis Sentinel for high availability.

## Motivation

Our current rate limiting solution uses a single Redis instance which has been a
single point of failure in production. We've experienced three outages in the last
quarter due to Redis going down.

## Changes

- Added `RateLimiter` struct backed by Redis Sentinel connection pool
- Implemented sliding window algorithm with configurable window size
- Added failover detection with automatic reconnection to new primary
- New Prometheus metrics for rate limit hits/misses
- Integration tests against a local Redis Sentinel cluster using testcontainers

## Configuration

```toml
[rate_limiting]
enabled = true
window_size_seconds = 60
max_requests = 1000
sentinel_addresses = ["sentinel-1:26379", "sentinel-2:26379", "sentinel-3:26379"]
master_name = "mymaster"
```

## Testing

- Unit tests for sliding window algorithm
- Integration tests with Redis Sentinel using testcontainers-rs
- Load tested with k6 at 10,000 RPS showing p99 latency under 2ms
- Chaos tested by killing sentinel nodes during traffic
